relationships.subject: Nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: the absence of nociception led to more severe and more lethal VOE, indicating that somatosensory nerves protect SCD mice from VOE

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Nociceptors thus inhibit VOE through CGRP.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: FACS analysis of the peripheral blood cells revealed significant reductions of aged neutrophil numbers in CGRP-treated SCD mice

relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: As the chili pepper extract capsaicin is a natural ligand of TRPV1

relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: oral capsaicin consumption, which can activate somatosensory nerves by binding to TRPV1, dramatically alleviated acute VOE

relationships.subject: Forskolin
relationships.evidence_quote: forskolin, like CGRP, protected SCD mice from VOE

key_findings: TRPV1-lineage nociceptor ablation worsened vaso-occlusive episodes in sickle cell mice; CGRP acting on hematopoietic cells was protective.
Dietary capsaicin (TRPV1 agonist) reduced aged neutrophils, VOE severity, and chronic liver and kidney damage without altering heat nociception.
